title: PRD: Modular Quality Bands for Hosted Endpoints — Acceptance & Rollout Tranche Plan
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Purpose: define a modular PRD that codifies 'quality bands' (gold/silver/bronze) per hosted endpoint profile (chat, completions, embeddings, rerank), align acceptance criteria to measurable telemetry, and provide a staged scope-reduction rollout plan to enable faster ship while protecting production SLOs. This ticket covers product decisions, acceptance tests, rollout tranches, and the launch checklist for the hosted API surface.

Summary of scope:
- Define three quality bands (Gold: deterministic constraints + tight latency targets; Silver: looser determinism with reduced cost; Bronze: best-effort low-cost lane).
- Map existing endpoint types (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank) to recommended default bands and optional cost/perf knobs.
- Specify acceptance criteria tied to real signals (p50/p95 latency, token cost delta, regen rate, eval-recall on seed prompts).
- Provide staged launch plan (Tranche A: Gold-only internal customers; Tranche B: Gold+Silver select customers; Tranche C: public with Bronze availability and cross-region fallbacks).
- Include rollback and degradation policies, telemetry dashboards, and SDK/contract compatibility checks.

Non-goals:
- This PRD is not the implementation work for kernel selection or runtime batching. It prescribes surface-level profiles and acceptance gates; engineering tasks live in ENG tickets.

Key artifacts and links:
- Design sketch: https://confluence.redwood.ai/endpoint-quality-bands
- Canonical eval sets: gs://redwood-evals/quality-bands/2025-02
- Rough telemetry dashboard (draft): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/hosted-quality-bands
acceptance_criteria: Gold band endpoints: p95 latency <= 250ms on 8k token window for 95% of production traffic in test region
Silver band endpoints: p95 latency <= 450ms and cost per token <= 1.5x baseline for targeted micro-batches
Bronze band endpoints: best-effort but must not increase client error rate (5xx) by more than 0.2 percentage points
Determinism: gold lane must pass deterministic regression harness on 10 canonical prompt pairs (no semantic regressions > 1.5% per eval)
Quality regression protection: cross-lane evals must show no drop > 3% for top-3 customer-critical prompts
SDK compatibility: no breaking contract changes for the existing hosted API surface; streaming and tool-calling must remain compatible
Fallback behavior: when capacity constrained, requests must route to a compatible lane with documented token-cost/latency differences
Operational readiness: alerting runbook linked and page on-call playbook updated (pager duty escalation + SLA burn rate thresholds)
Security: security review sign-off recorded and key management integration verified for private keys used in protected lanes
launch_checklist: Finalize band definitions and map of default allocations per endpoint type
Complete canary test plan and smoke tests for each lane (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank)
Publish SDK compatibility notes and migration guidance to dev portal
Instrument telemetry: p50/p95 latency, token-cost, regen-rate, client-error-rate, model-fidelity-score
Bake eval harness into CI for staged rollouts and require green for Tranche promotions
Create customer opt-in flow for Tranche B and internal-only signup for Tranche A
Run cost-simulation for Bronze lane under expected workload profile and validate committed unit economics
Security review completed and compliance artifacts uploaded
Prepare rollback matrix + automated routing config to switch lanes under capacity pressure
Customer communications draft and support FAQ published
Run a tabletop exercise for outage and graceful degradation scenarios
rollout_plan: Tranche A (internal): 2-week smoke with internal customers, focus on Gold band only; monitor core SLOs and fidelity probes
Tranche B (partners): 4-week limited rollout to opt-in customers with Gold+Silver lanes; collect feedback and cost telemetry
Tranche C (public): gradual release with Bronze lane available as a low-cost option and regional fallbacks enabled; progressive ramp over 6 weeks
Promotion gates: must meet acceptance criteria and have zero critical Sev1 regressions for 7 consecutive days before moving between tranches
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Bronze lane causes higher-than-expected hallucination/regression on edge prompts. Mitigation: require Bronze to run a lightweight rerank or confidence filter for top-k outputs and surface a warning flag in response metadata.
Risk: Cost delta with Silver lane erodes customer economics. Mitigation: run pre-launch simulations and implement dynamic batching thresholds and autoscale caps per tenant.
Risk: Regional capacity imbalance during public rollouts. Mitigation: enable smart routing to alternate regions and document latency/cost tradeoffs to customers.
Risk: Incomplete telemetry coverage. Mitigation: gating acceptance on a telemetry checklist and blocking Tranche promotion until metrics are verified in dashboards
